+## What
+
+marketplace.md §13 (the update cycle). One test proves that the parts work together, in the same shape as the hot-reload test in plan.md §13. It is hermetic: libgit2 over `file://`, with no network and no `git` binary. If the test finds a defect, fix it in this task.
+
+`Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/MarketplaceEndToEndTests.swift`:
+1. With `GitFixtureRepository`, make marketplace A in our own format (§3.2–3.3): `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` with one plugin, `skills/alpha/SKILL.md` and `skills/beta/SKILL.md`, both with `{% include "_partials/sah-header" %}`, and `skills/_partials/sah-header.md`. Make marketplace B with its own `skills/_partials/sah-header.md` (different text) and a skill `gamma` that includes it.
+2. Make a local `user` layer with its own `beta`.
+3. Build `MarketplaceStore(sources: [A, B])` with a temporary cache, and `SkillsRegistry(marketplaces:stack:)`. Build a `SkillsTool` over the registry with the counting embedder that the existing hot-reload tests use.
+4. `await store.start()`. Assert: `alpha` comes from A and renders A's header; `gamma` renders B's header; `beta` is the local one, and a shadow diagnostic names marketplace A; all marketplace skills render untrusted.
+5. Commit a change to `alpha` in A. Call `store.update()`. Assert: exactly one `onReload` value; exactly one searcher `update(items:)`; `use skill alpha` shows the new body; the old snapshot is kept as the one previous snapshot.
+6. Make A unreachable (move the fixture folder). Call `update()`. Assert `.failed` with `keptVersion`, and `alpha` still renders.
+

+- [ ] Assertions after the first sync (sources, partial scope, shadowing, trust)
+- [ ] The update cycle with one reload and one searcher update
+- [ ] The failure case
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The test passes in the unit CI job with no network
+- [ ] Every assertion in steps 4–6 holds
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/MarketplaceEndToEndTests.swift` as described
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter MarketplaceEndToEndTests`; then `swift test`; all green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.

+    - `SnapshotWriter.copyPartials` copies the `_partials/` folder of the parent folder of each selected skill. With skills at `skills/<id>`, `skills/_partials/sah-header.md` lands at `<snapshot>/_partials/sah-header.md`.

+    - `MarketplaceStore.update()` publishes a layer update only when a pass installs a snapshot. Marketplace B changes nothing, thus one `update()` over both marketplaces still gives exactly one reload.
+    - `check()` never installs, also with the default policy.
+
+    Two mutation probes proved that the new assertions bind, and each failed for the correct reason:
+    - `alpha` asserted against the header of marketplace B: failed. Decision 9 partial scope holds.
+    - The snapshot set asserted as `[second]` only: failed. The store keeps the one previous snapshot.
